title: Pancakes
steps: Whisk flour, sugar, eggs and milk into a smooth batter.
Melt a little butter in a pan and fry thin pancakes, 1-2 minutes per side.

title: Spaghetti al pomodoro
steps: Fry sliced garlic in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente, drain and toss with the sauce.
